output.answer_markdown: The filings provided do not describe a 2022 spin-off of AWS, so they cannot show how one would have changed consolidated revenue. They do state that Amazon organizes its operations into three segments, North America, International, and AWS [1]. They also describe net sales as including product and service sales [2].

provenance.quote: We have organized our operations into three segments: North America, International, and AWS.

claims.text: Amazon organizes its operations into three segments: North America, International, and AWS.

provenance.quote: Net sales include product and service sales.

claims.text: Net sales include product and service sales.

found: AWS is reported as one of three segments alongside North America and International.
Net sales include product and service sales, with AWS sales among the service sales.
missing: Any disclosure of a 2022 spin-off or separation of AWS from Amazon.
Consolidated net sales figures comparing the periods before and after such a spin-off, or a statement that no spin-off occurred.
refusal.reason: The provided material does not mention a 2022 spin-off of AWS or any effect of such a spin-off on consolidated net sales.
